text: Kiri told me at lunch that she's expecting! Due date is March 2027, and she's already had a rough few weeks of morning sickness.
Remind me to ask Siddharth how the client pitch went on Thursday. He was really nervous about presenting to their board.

Gabriel and his wife are flying to Tokyo on May 14 for two weeks. Their first proper holiday since the twins were born. His mother-in-law is having the kids, and he's already worried about how the boys will cope without them for that long. He wants restaurant tips for Kyoto too.
Dev's manager is leaving at the end of the month. He thinks he might get her role but doesn't want to jinx it.
Joseph's daughter is being christened on 2 November 2026 at St Mary's. I'm godmother, so I need to sort out a gift before then.
Jada is vegetarian and hates long-haul flights. Worth remembering if we ever do the team trip to Singapore.
Amara had the baby! A little girl called Zara, born June 3rd, 7lb 2oz. Must send flowers to the hospital this week.
Lachlan's trip to Peru is off. His mum broke her hip, so he's staying home to help her through the recovery.
Pick up euros and the travel adapter before Friday. Flight is at 6am on the 22nd.

Tendai has started at Okafor & Partners as a junior analyst. He says his new boss, Graham, is a bit intense but fair. The first big client meeting is on 11/18, and he's been asked to present the numbers, which is a lot for someone in his second month. He's already rehearsing in front of his girlfriend.
Aarav and Saanvi are expecting their second in the spring. Their eldest, Rohan, keeps asking if it's going to be a brother.
Lorenzo mentioned he's been collecting vintage travel posters for years. He'd love an old Pan Am one, which would make a great Christmas present.

Call with Mila. Her performance review got moved from 10/28 to November 4th, and she's anxious about it because her line manager has been cold with her lately. I should check in with her the day after.
Catalina's sister Lola is getting married in Lisbon next August. The whole family is flying out, and Catalina is already stressing about the seating plan.
Andre said the Johnson account is moving to his team from January. Don't forget to send him the old project notes.
Graham retires on December 12th after thirty-one years. There's a leaving do at the Crown that evening, and someone is collecting for a card.
Idris has a dog called Biscuit who apparently hates the vet more than anything. Biscuit's having his teeth done next Tuesday.
Ayesha's mum has her scan on 5/14. Ayesha is pretty worried about it, so I need to text her that afternoon to see how it went.
Laura is back from her honeymoon in Bali. She said the flight home was nineteen hours and she never wants to see an airport again.
Note to self: renew my passport before March 2027. It runs out in June and some countries need six months left.
Suzanne got the promotion to head of client services! Starts officially on January 6th. Remind me to get her a card.
Carlos and his partner have booked a three-week road trip around New Zealand starting February 9th. He asked me for recommendations in the South Island.
Nia is twelve weeks pregnant and only told her boss today. She seemed relieved it went well.
Keisha's baby shower is on Saturday, April 18th. I'm doing the cake, and Jess is handling decorations.
Ravi said his flight to Delhi got cancelled twice this week. He finally gets out on Sunday the 9th, but he'll miss his cousin's mehndi.

Jess has been struggling since she came back from maternity leave. The new manager keeps scheduling meetings at 5pm when she has nursery pick-up, and she feels like she's been quietly pushed off the big accounts. She's thinking of going part-time after Christmas. I should take her for a coffee next week and just listen.
Lwazi's brother Sipho is moving to Toronto in the new year for a job at a bank. Lwazi is gutted but proud.
Ask Georgia how her first week at the agency went. She started on Monday and was quite nervous beforehand.
Zeynep and Oscar's son, Emre, is being christened in Istanbul on July 19th. They're asking if we can fly out for it.
Oscar mentioned his boss, Mrs Kim, is off on long-term sick leave. Nobody knows when she'll be back, and the team is stretched thin.

Kiri's due date got moved forward to February 27th because of her blood pressure. Her husband Joseph is trying to keep her off her feet, which she hates because she wanted to work right up until the end. Her mum is coming down from Leeds to help. I should drop round some meals next week and give her a call before the weekend.
Siddharth (Sid to everyone at work) is off to Iceland for his fortieth on October 30th. His wife organised the whole thing as a surprise.
Gabriel asked if I could cover his clients while he's away from 6/2 to 6/16. Need to get handover notes from him by the end of May.
Dev's mum is turning seventy on 8 January 2027. He's planning a family trip to Goa for it and wants ideas for a gift she'd actually use.
Great catch-up with Jada. She's thinking about quitting to go travelling for a year, probably starting in Vietnam.
Amara said Zara is feeding well now but not sleeping at all. She sounded exhausted. Remind me to message her on Friday and offer to take the baby for a walk so she can nap.

Lachlan's new client, Mr Wang, has rejected the proposal again. Third time this month. He's meeting him in person on November 11th to try and save it. If it falls through, his boss has hinted the whole team could be restructured in the new year. He's barely sleeping. Remind me to text Lachlan on the 11th to see how it went.
Tendai is learning Portuguese before his trip to Brazil next spring. He's on a 200-day streak on his app.
Christening was lovely. Must remember to send Joseph and Laura the photos from the church.
Lorenzo and Mila had their anniversary dinner cancelled because the restaurant flooded. They're going to try again in a couple of weeks.
Catalina says her client in Madrid wants her out there for a week in March 2027. She's not keen as she has a toddler at home.
Andre's wife Kiri is a midwife at the Royal. She's the one who delivered Amara's baby, funnily enough.
Graham's grandson Leo was born on September 28th. He showed me about forty photos. Need to get a little card for him before Friday.
Idris got back from Morocco on Sunday. Ask him whether the hike up Toubkal went ahead; the weather looked awful when he left.

Ayesha is pregnant with twins! She's due in late April, but her doctor said twins usually come early. Her husband Carlos is already building two cots, and her sister Georgia has offered to move in for the first month. They've cancelled their trip to Italy in January because she isn't allowed to fly after twenty-eight weeks. Need to find a nice gift for two.
Long day. Client call ran over by an hour, then the train was delayed. Going to bed.
Laura's colleague Suzanne Thomas is off on maternity leave from 12/1. Laura is covering her accounts and is quietly panicking about it.
Lola told me Andre has been offered a secondment to the Singapore office for six months from April 2027. He hasn't decided yet, and his partner isn't thrilled.
Spoke to Nia on the phone. Her scan on Wednesday showed the baby is breech, so they'll check again at thirty-six weeks. She's trying not to worry.

Keisha's dad is having knee surgery on May 20th, the same week her team is presenting to the Lopez Group. She's torn about whether to take the week off. Her manager, Andre, told her to take it, but she's worried the client will think she's not committed. Her dad lives on his own, so someone has to be there for the first few days after he comes home.
Ravi's daughter Priya starts nursery on September 1st. He and his wife are both more nervous than she is. Remind me to text Ravi on the day to see how drop-off went.
Jess and her husband are hoping to go to Greece in June for her sister's wedding, but they're waiting on the passport for the baby.
Lwazi said the conference in Cape Town has been called off. He's relieved, honestly, as he wasn't ready to give the keynote.
Book the airport parking and check in online for Thursday. Also buy the travel cot for Barcelona.
Georgia's new manager, Dr Suzuki, seems lovely. Georgia says she's the first boss who's actually asked about her goals.
Zeynep is flying back from Ankara on the 3rd after her grandmother's funeral. I should call her once she's home and settled.

Oscar is mad about cycling and is doing the London to Paris ride on June 12th. He's been training every weekend since January, mostly with his brother Idris, who did it last year. Oscar's knee has been playing up, but the physio said he should be fine as long as he doesn't overdo it in the next few weeks. Don't forget to sponsor him.
Kiri hinted that she'd love one of those fancy baby carriers for the new arrival. Maybe the team could chip in.

Had a really nice chat with Saanvi about her trip to Japan. She went in April last year and still talks about the food in Osaka. Her husband Aarav is allergic to shellfish, which apparently made sushi tricky. They're thinking of going back next year with the kids, maybe in late March for the cherry blossom, if they can face a twelve-hour flight with a four-year-old.

Mila's maternity leave starts on 2 November 2026 and she's due on the 20th. Her mum is flying over from Rome to stay for a month. Siddharth is taking over her team in the meantime, and he's nervous about managing Dev and Jada, who both applied for the role. Remind me to wish Mila luck the week before and ask Sid how his first week went.
